commits.purpose: Merge required component branches before implementation
Production episode backend, additive worker hook and CPU contracts
Whole-update trigger KL, durable checkpoint identity and additional CPU coverage

additive_shared_hook.description: After normal/practice V2V controller construction, install production policy/controller components only for explicit Track-2 jobs. Existing requests, command ownership and feasibility enforcement remain the execution path.

api.build_arm_runtime(cfg, arm): Returns hooks containing runtime, policy, policy_factory, bank_pairs, collect_update, safety, train_update, save_checkpoint and episode_components. No physics is dispatched by building hooks.
api.collect_update(cfg, arm, u): Rebuilds the pre-update runtime and returns real accel_runner episode receipts, including per-step track2/track2_trigger/coop_layer records for B/R.
hook_order: Set cfg.update=u and build hooks; A collection must precede same-update B/R safety references.
Collect episodes with hooks.collect_update() or collect_update(cfg, arm, u).
Run hooks.safety(episodes); same-update normal A results are required and matched practice A references are charged through the same wave.
P2 label_update produces labels and group credit.
Pass episode and optimizer diagnostics to P3, then hooks.save_checkpoint(). Publish the parent's update receipt, including the inherited practice update_report, before R practice collection.
api.dense_targets: One candidate-table index per CAV in the recorded track2_trigger batch; padded/masked targets refuse.
required_common_config: worlds_by_update (string update keys, registered TRAIN-world records)
api.coop3_options: v2v_intent keys, replay_sources, practice_starts/practice_fraction/practice_repeat_cap, practice_weighting/practice_weighted_fraction, imitation_epochs and imitation_step_mode pass through to their real readers/learners.
api.accounting: Own run_root/CHARGES.jsonl and ACCOUNTING.claim; budget.total <=5000000, phase_map.train defaults to track2_train, prior_charged_sim_s defaults to 960 and cannot be below 960. Parent allocations must include smoke and matched practice references. No inherited 17M budget is installed.
api.approval: Collection requires OWNER_APPROVAL.json with approved=true; owner_approval_sha256 is checked when supplied. Parent launch/registration/source gates remain required.
api.checkpoint: Normal {arm}_checkpoint_{u:03}.pt plus B/R {arm}_track2_{u:03}.pt sidecar with layer/trigger weights and Adam states; exclusive writes, strict arm/update restoration.
api.compatibility_adapter: Local TriggerMove/MoveAPI bridges accepted T1A onset/hold to accepted T2A onset_s/hold_s without changing either component.

implementation.A: Inherited V2V MAPPO PPO without cooperation layer or bank updates.
implementation.B_and_R: Same frozen-base cooperation-layer/trigger architecture, optimizers, practice scheduling and effective-bank pipeline; teacher identity/filtering comes from P2.
implementation.zero_init: Residual and committed-move gain start at zero; sampled base action bytes and base exploration RNG advancement are identical.
implementation.observable_inputs: Layer uses local 29 sensor features, separate merge block and recorded committed-move offset. Trigger uses separate local-only t-1 intent messages and zero broadcast latent. No RSU/global channel enters layer/trigger features.
implementation.move_execution: Observable CAV candidates, stable nonoverlap arbitration, registered move offsets/onset/hold and wall release; requests continue through the existing single-writer plant path.
implementation.learning: T2D transactional layer-only PPO with P2 group advantages; T2A categorical PPO and dense CE have a whole-update exact joint categorical KL bound and restore weights plus Adam state on rejection. Executed prefix/committed-plan steps are excluded from own-action PPO.
implementation.bank: Existing per_seed_v1 cooperative-only reader and transactional separate-full-pass effective imitation; only cooperation parameters change. Recorded limits use the registered shared 1.2 cap passed explicitly to attach_limits, avoiding a population-truth lookup.
implementation.practice: Existing frozen plans, weighting and augmentation consumer, R=B realised count, batch dispatch, normal-world replacement exclusion, prefix stripping and pre-update A matched safety references.
implementation.horizon: Production job construction keeps the inherited 1200 sim-s charge and 300..1199 control ticks; no look-ahead/horizon cut.

verification.full_worker_test: Actual accel_plant.episode, real V2V controller, models, 900 control ticks, 15 decision intervals, compressed receipt writer; only physics/setup/seed guards replaced by CPU test fakes.
verification.other_coverage: Frozen base, zero-init RNG/action parity, local observation invariance, t-1 merge reports, nonoverlap/expiry/wall release, plain A PPO, group-credit joins, confidence filtering, nonempty effective imitation, practice scheduling/fairness/safety, accounting cap/duplicates, KL rejection/Adam rollback and real checkpoint round-trip.
verification.earlier_regression_attempt: Broad run exceeded the 120s tool window. A focused rerun reproduced three inherited launch-provenance fixture failures (24 passed, 3 failed); those three were explicitly deselected from the successful 250-test regression.

Worktree-local basetemp makes launch3 correctly refuse package fallback with 'deployed checkout identity unavailable; package provenance cannot bypass Git'. No launch3 gate or inherited test was changed.
